pageTitle: hub by Premier Inn | London Shoreditch
pageDescription: Our hub by Premier Inn London Shoreditch hotel is on Shoreditch High Street, close to Brick Lane, galleries and Old Street Underground station.
hotelDescription:
Stay on Shoreditch High Street and experience London at its most exciting when you book at our hub by Premier Inn London Shoreditch hotel. There’s so much to do nearby, go shopping on iconic Brick Lane, visit Chance Street or stop by Hales Gallery. Shoreditch is famous for its nightlife, with iconic bars like Cargo and much, much more just around the corner from us. Our hotel makes exploring London easy, we’re just a 15-minute walk from Old Street, Liverpool Street and Aldgate East Underground stations. Take a trip to Big Ben, lose yourself in the National Portrait Gallery and relax in Hyde Park without worrying about getting home in time. For more must-see places to visit and things to do, take a look at our guide to London and our other Premier Inn hotels in Shoreditch.

After a busy day out in Shoreditch, look forward to relaxing in one of our expertly designed hub rooms. From convenient touchscreen controls that let you control your room’s lighting and temperature, to inviting double beds and high-spec en-suite bathrooms, sleek pull-out desks and plenty of under-bed storage, our stylish, compact rooms are cleverly designed around you. Catch up with friends online or watch the latest blockbuster movies through your 40" smart TV. Stay connected with super-fast, free Wi-Fi*, and experience the city at your fingertips.

You can choose between Standard and Bigger hub rooms at this hotel.
hotelDirections:
Underground: The hotel is a 11 minute walk from Liverpool Street Station. Exit the station and follow Bishopsgate/A10 towards New St. Turn right onto Brushfield St. Turn left onto Commercial St/A1202. Turn right onto Hanbury St. Turn left onto Corbet Pl. Turn right onto Grey Eagle St, hotel on your right.

Overground: the hotel is a 4 minute walk from Shoreditch High Street railway station, exit the station and walk east. Turn right onto Wheler St. Turn left onto Quaker St. Turn right onto Grey Eagle St

restaurant.name: Lounge
restaurant.description: Start your day with breakfast including fresh toast, pastries, fruit, yoghurt and porridge, plus unlimited tea, coffee and orange juice. Just ask to add breakfast to your stay at reception. Later, tuck into our tasty deli boards or range of sandwiches, soups, salads and home comfort dishes. In the evening, join us for a tipple or two during our cocktail Happy Hour. From 5pm-8pm, buy any drink from our menu and enjoy a complimentary cheese plate on us.*

menus.name: Breakfast
menus.description: Start your day right with a mix of continental breakfast items and a selection of hot cooked food. From sausage, scrambled egg and bacon to fresh pastries, toast, fruit salad, yoghurts and porridge, just tuck in. Plus there’s unlimited coffee, Twinings tea and orange juice, too.
menus.disclaimer: Depending on your selected hotel and dates you stay, we will be offering different breakfast and evening options.

menus.name: Dinner
menus.description: Grab a bite to eat and tuck into favourites like nachos with chilli con carne, margherita pizza or a delicious chicken makhani curry. Some of our dishes are also available for you to take away and enjoy in your room.
menus.disclaimer: Depending on your selected hotel and dates you stay, we will be offering different breakfast and evening options.

infoItems.text: Liverpool Street underground and overground station - 0.6 miles

faqItems.question: How far is Shoreditch from Central London?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Shoreditch is about 30 minutes away from Central London on the route 11 bus or via the Underground. Take the Central Line from Liverpool Street station to Tottenham Court Road station, change to the Northern Line and get off at Charing Cross station, just moments away from Trafalgar Square.

faqItems.question: Which part of London is Shoreditch?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Shoreditch is in the East End of London, part of Greater London and close to Brick Lane and Spitalfields Market. Shoreditch crosses the boroughs of Hackney and Tower Hamlets, and is just under three miles from Central London.

faqItems.question: Why is Shoreditch so popular?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Shoreditch is popular for its lively nightlife and pioneering trends in art, food and music. The area is a favourite spot for fashion lovers and there’s always something new to experience such as pop-up restaurants and live shows.

faqItems.question: How far is Shoreditch from Covent Garden?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Shoreditch is about 30 minutes away from Covent Garden on the route 11 bus or via the Underground. Take the Central Line from Liverpool Street station to Holborn station, then change to the Piccadilly Line for Covent Garden station.

faqItems.question: How would you describe Shoreditch?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Shoreditch is lively, innovative and fun. Shoreditch has changed from a space for run-down warehouses and industrial yards, to somewhere for free-thinkers to follow their dreams. With boutique galleries, pop-up street food stalls and an unstoppable nightlife scene, Shoreditch is a great place to try new things and enjoy a great night

faqItems.question: Is Shoreditch a good night out?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Some would say the best night out in London. Cargo is a popular bar and club, with international and resident DJs, two dancefloors and an outdoor terrace. Old Street Records, Trapeze and Shoreditch Platform are also favourites, but there are plenty more on Shoreditch High Street

faqItems.question: What is there to do in Shoreditch on a Saturday?
faqItems.acceptedAnswer: Find amazing bargains and food at Spitalfields Market, enjoy a movie at the Electric Cinema and spend the night partying at countless bars and clubs nearby
